newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-WP WIN S.AFRICA INTER-PROVINCIAL TITLE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WP WIN S.AFRICA INTER-PROVINCIAL TITLE.

text.p: Western Province won
the inter-provincial championship at Clovelly Country Club on
Thursday by completing their fourth succcessive victory.
They crushed bottom of the log Border, ten and a half to one
and a half, to claim their first title since 1993 having
finished fourth out of five last season.
After clinching the morning foursomes by three and a half to
a half point, Western Province romped to a 7-1 victory in the
singles with only two of the eight matches going to the 18th.
It was Province's eighth title since the competition began
in 1960 and the first time they have won it on home turf since
taking the title at Hermanus in 1972.
In Section B the President's Development team of golfers
from underprivileged backgrounds gave themselves a chance of
finishing top of their log with a second victory in three
matches, defeating Eastern Transvaal, eight and a half to three
and a half.
Scores:
Western Province (2 pts) beat Border (0 pts), 10 and a half
to 1 and a half. Foursomes: Western Province 3 and a half, Natal
a half. Singles: Western Province 7, Border 1.
Natal (2 pts) beat Southern Transvaal (0pts) by 6 and a half
to 5 and a half. Foursomes: Natal 2, Southern Transvaal 2.
Singles: Natal 4 and a half, Southern Transvaal 3 and a half.
